Adversarially verify this code-review finding from the M12 diff. Read the actual code (git diff main...HEAD + the file) and try to REFUTE it. Default to isReal=false if it's a false positive, pre-existing, out of scope, or already handled.

Lens: reuse
Severity: low
File: messages/en.json (account.removeFavorite, account.cancelConfirm, account.settingsHeading)
Title: Three dead message keys added but never referenced
Detail: This diff adds `account.removeFavorite` ("Remove {name} from favorites"), `account.cancelConfirm` ("Cancel this booking?"), and `account.settingsHeading` ("Payment & settings") to the catalog, but grep across app/ and components/ shows zero usages of any of them. `account.removeFavorite` is also a duplicate of `favorite.remove` ("Remove {name} from favorites"), which is the key actually used by FavoriteButton. `account.settingsHeading` duplicates the used `account.settingsTitle`. `account.cancelConfirm` was evidently authored for a cancel confirmation that was never wired up (see related finding).
Suggestion: Remove the three unused keys. FavoriteButton already uses `favorite.remove`, and the settings pages use `account.settingsTitle`/`settingsLink`, so nothing else needs to change.
